guide.priorLine: @MundoDeportivo is a general sports outlet that publishes frequent Barça-specific transfer, match and personnel stories but mixes them with a larger volume of Real Madrid, other-club, other-sport and lifestyle content, so each post must be judged individually for a Barça angle.

examplesEnglish: Kuzey Kiliç, reinforcement for Barça basketball's sporting structure
Green light for Xevi Pujol's arrival at Barça
Ferran Torres is not for sale

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Preseason player interview/quotes from St. George's Park
examplesEnglish: Xavi Espart: 'Because it's for Barça, I'd play in any position'
Cortés: 'My time in the reserve team has passed, I want to be in the first team'

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Preseason match/schedule news (Barça Atlètic, friendly vs Preston)
examplesEnglish: 2-1: Barça Atlètic falls in its debut but shows quality
Barça's friendly match against Preston suspended

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Front-page roundup dominated by Barça news
examplesEnglish: Front page: Barça rules out selling Ferran despite noise in France about a move to PSG; club has the World Cup final's top scorer and wants to extend his contract, which expires next year - 'NOT FOR SALE'

offBeatPatterns.pattern: Real Madrid news with no Barça angle
examplesEnglish: Sudden problem with Diomande and Real Madrid
Real Madrid: open casting call at right-back

offBeatPatterns.pattern: Other clubs' transfer news unrelated to Barça
examplesEnglish: Chelsea, signing player by player, has already invested 400 million euros
Big money for Cucurella's replacement: Rayo Vallecano and Chelsea close to a deal for Pep Chavarría

offBeatPatterns.pattern: Other sports coverage (basketball nationals, tennis, padel, rally, sailing)
examplesEnglish: 69-74: Spain falls to France in a tight finish and misses out on bronze
Chingotto-Galán end Guerrero-Leal's dream and use it to cut into the number ones

offBeatPatterns.pattern: Celebrity/lifestyle or consumer content unrelated to football
examplesEnglish: José Luis Puchol, 72-year-old vet: 'The reputation pitbull terriers have is horrendous, yet they are quite affectionate dogs'
#TheRecommender: My back couldn't handle a full day sitting and now it withstands 8 hours thanks to this ergonomic chair
